[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37312]Original TwoCircles Mod for SVE[/url] - install it first

[s] This seems to be almost obsolete as original mods cover almost everything. So far I've found two issues - Gunther sprite and Sandy portrait. I see no reason in trying to fix that rn. Based on what I've seen, TwoCircles is going to add seasonal outfits for Gunther. After that I may return to it if there's need. [/s] 
Since author has been inactive for more than month, I've decided to release fix for this. Gunther and Sandy with SVE are fixed, Witch with RomRas also should be, but I haven't tested it. 

Resize Portraits Size updates will be uploaded [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36670]here[/url]
